policy.docsOnly: Validate links and JSON, then run git diff --check. Do not run product tests.
policy.implementationLoop: Run one most relevant focused command. Add a second only when the first cannot cover the changed boundary.
policy.verticalSlice: Focused tests, affected typecheck/build only when relevant, at most one representative Electron path, and diff review.
policy.phaseGate: Run the full phase gate once per final SHA. Reuse equivalent green evidence on the same SHA.
policy.e2eFailure: Read the first trace or screenshot, make one targeted correction, and rerun only the failed spec once.

documentation-index.when: Only Markdown or repo-index JSON changed

editor-shell-layout.when: App shell, grid, viewport height, CSS overflow, state strip or status bar changed

slide-session-and-layers.fast: npx vitest run tests/unit/v9SlideVerticalSlice.test.ts tests/unit/v9SlideLayerSession.test.ts tests/unit/v9SlideLayerRegression.test.ts

surface-scope.when: Surface scope, shared items, base/effective visibility or stale targets changed

global-controller-authoring.when: Global controller authoring, health check or controller session behavior changed

published-interactions.fast: npx vitest run tests/unit/interactionEngine.test.ts tests/unit/interactionSchema.test.ts tests/unit/coursePublishPipeline.test.ts
published-interactions.when: Interaction engine, Published App, SlideSurfaceHost or published interaction payload changed

runtime-component-compatibility.when: Runtime API, Component API or explicit V8 import compatibility changed

flow.when: Flow model, authoring projection, Host or export changed

spatial.when: No dedicated current suite is indexed; add focused tests with the first Spatial authoring vertical slice rather than running the whole repository

published-delivery.fast: npx vitest run tests/unit/coursePublishPipeline.test.ts tests/unit/export.test.ts tests/unit/exportPreflight.test.ts
published-delivery.when: Published producer, Player bundle, HTML/web package or export preflight changed

phase-gate.build: Build only affected bundles; use npm run build:desktop only when Renderer, Player and Electron all changed
phase-gate.when: Once on the final phase SHA; visual only when shell DOM/CSS/viewport changed

final-m8.additional: Representative archive, Published V2, Runtime 2/3, Component 4 and five-format export inspection
final-m8.when: Once at M8; reuse unchanged M7 delivery evidence

e2ePreparation.rule: Run only when Renderer, Electron, Player or generated course-case inputs changed. Reuse the existing build for test-only locator changes.
